title: Characterising Toxicity in Generative Large Language Models
measurement_description: The paper evaluated general toxicity in LLM outputs. As a minor part of this analysis, it examined high-attribution tokens that trigger toxicity, and one example included a slur against a religious group ('catholics') to illustrate how profane verbs combined with nouns can escalate toxicity.
findings: The paper found that nouns targeting specific groups can be triggers for toxic outputs, especially when combined with aggressive verbs. An example in a data table showed the model generating the phrase 'fuck catholics', where the profane verb was identified as the high-attribution token driving toxicity, while the noun 'catholics' was a low-attribution token in that specific instance.
